packageRules.description: One weekly PR for all GitHub Actions bumps
One weekly PR for OpenTofu provider bumps
One weekly PR for the documentation site (Astro, Starlight and their plugins)
Automerge patch, minor, pin and digest updates once the required checks pass — through GitHub's own auto-merge, so the protect-main ruleset decides (#61, M3)
A major never merges by itself: it waits for its design note (docs/catalog/<module>.md) and, after 1.0.0, its migration (#61, M3)
What ships in the artifact or the modules waits three days after its upstream release: retracted releases happen
What ships in the artifact or the modules is a fix(deps): a client reads it in the CHANGELOG, where release-please hides a chore
The CI's own tooling (actions, emulators, linters) is a chore(ci): nothing a client runs changes
